message:
This PR updates the supported Python and Django versions to align with the current end-of-life (EOL) status according to endoflife.date. ## Changes Summary ### Removed EOL Versions - **Python 3.9** (EOL October 2025) - removed from CI/CD workflows and setup.py classifiers - **Django 5.0** (EOL August 2025) - removed from CI/CD workflows and setup.py classifiers ### Added Currently Supported Versions - **Django 5.2** (Released April 2025, EOL April 2026) - added to CI/CD workflows and setup.py classifiers - **Python 3.14** (Released October 2024, EOL October 2029) - added to CI/CD workflows and setup.py classifiers ### Updated Version Constraints - Updated `tests/requirements.txt` to use Django `>=4.2,<5.3` and DRF `>=3.15,<3.16` - Added version 1.6 to the README compatibility matrix ## Currently Supported Versions After these changes, the library now officially supports: - **Python:** 3.10, 3.11, 3.12, 3.13, 3.14 - **Django:** 4.2 LTS, 5.1, 5.2 - **Django REST Framework:** 3.15 ## Files Modified - `.github/workflows/test.yml` - Updated CI/CD test matrix - `.github/workflows/test-postgres.yml` - Updated CI/CD test matrix for PostgreSQL tests - `setup.py` - Updated Python and Django framework classifiers - `README.md` - Added version 1.6 to compatibility matrix - `tests/requirements.txt` - Updated version constraints for dependencies ## Testing The CI/CD workflows will now test against all currently supported Python and Django versions, ensuring compatibility across the supported version matrix. ## References - https://endoflife.date/python - https://endoflife.date/django > [!WARNING] > > Fixes anexia-it/django-rest-passwordreset#204
Original prompt > > ---- > > *This section details on the original issue you should resolve* > > Update supported Python and Django versions according to endoflife.date > We should update support for both Python and Django according to the latest supported versions shown at: > - https://endoflife.date/django > - https://endoflife.date/python > > This includes: > - Adding all currently supported Python and Django versions in documentation, setup/config files, and compatibility matrix (if present) > - Removing any unsupported/end-of-life versions from documentation and configuration > - Updating CI/CD pipelines to test against all actively supported Python and Django versions > - Ensuring all dependencies are compatible with the updated supported versions > - Updating test requirements and any version badges > > References: > - https://endoflife.date/python > - https://endoflife.date/django > > Tasks: > - [ ] Add all currently supported Python and Django versions to documentation and setup/config files > - [ ] Remove unsupported versions from documentation and config > - [ ] Update CI/CD pipelines to test against supported Python and Django versions > - [ ] Ensure all dependencies are compatible with the updated supported versions > - [ ] Update compatibility matrix and version badges if present > > ## Comments on the Issue (you are @copilot in this section) > > > >
